title: Evaluation of the canonical open singleton insertion is the open scalar projection
statement: Let O be a commutative ring, t an element, f:X→Y a scheme morphism, c a compactification and S:StrictEtaleCompactSupport O t c [def-per-strict-etale-system-interfaces]. Fix m≤n and a natural isomorphism q from scalar extension on X followed by level-m open extension to level-n open extension followed by scalar extension on c.Z. Suppose its mate for the two level open extension/inverse-image adjunctions equals the inverse of S.openDerived.derivedTensor. Form insertion by conjugating S.openDerived.inverseEvaluation at level n under the composite singleton/open adjunctions. For every derived level-n object P on X, evaluation at m of insertion(P) followed by derivedBelow on c.Z at the level-n open extension of P equals openDerivedEvaluation at the singleton extension of P, then level-m open extension of derivedBelow on X at P, then q at P. No finiteness, Brown adjoint, or proper singleton mate is assumed.

proof.text: Prove the singleton below-level Hom-transpose formula from derivedBelow_rep, hom_formula, the normalized derived adjunctions and transition_rep on flat-term K-flat representatives, and descend to the arbitrary fixed derived packages.

Transpose through the level open adjunction and scalar adjunction. The prescribed mate equation for q and inverseTransition identify the coefficient factors. The defining conjugate equation of insertion and the evaluated open adjunction identify the remaining factors. Injectivity of both transposes gives the displayed equality.

theorem etaleBrownOpenSingletonEvaluation
    (S : StrictEtaleCompactSupport O t c) {m n : ℕ} (h : m ≤ n)
    (q : (S.PX.scalar h).derived ⋙ S.levelDerivedOpen m ≅
      S.levelDerivedOpen n ⋙ (S.PZ.scalar h).derived)
    (hq : (mateEquiv (S.levelDerivedOpenAdjunction n) (S.levelDerivedOpenAdjunction m)
      (.mk _ _ _ _ q.hom)).natTrans = (S.openDerived.derivedTensor h).inv)
    (P : DerivedCategory (strictEtaleLevel X O t n)) :
    let insertion := ((conjugateIsoEquiv
      ((S.PX.derivedAdj n).comp S.derivedOpenAdjunction)
      ((S.levelDerivedOpenAdjunction n).comp (S.PZ.derivedAdj n))).symm
        (S.openDerived.inverseEvaluation n)).symm
    (S.PZ.evaluation m).map (insertion.hom.app P) ≫
      (S.PZ.derivedBelow h).hom.app ((S.levelDerivedOpen n).obj P) =
    (S.openDerivedEvaluation m).hom.app ((S.PX.derivedExtension n).obj P) ≫
      (S.levelDerivedOpen m).map ((S.PX.derivedBelow h).hom.app P) ≫ q.hom.app P
